description: Run a recorded automation script, including compatible Maestro YAML flows. A script without a terminal close leaves its session active for subsequent automation. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

bundleUrl.description: Bundle URL hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

keepSession.description: Leave the session active by suppressing exactly an authored terminal close in native .ad.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

metroHost.description: Metro/debug host hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

metroPort.description: Metro/debug port hint inherited by replay-opened sessions.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

testIme.description: Activate the headless Android test IME for the sessions this replay opens (default on for emulators; opt-in on real devices).

timeoutMs.description: Operation wall-clock budget in milliseconds (default 60000). The client allows another 30000 milliseconds for the daemon result.

name: replay
